facts: HMLR_OS_NOT_LEGAL_BOUNDARIES
Ordnance Survey mapping is multi-purpose topographic mapping and is not intended to represent legal property boundaries.
HMLR_MASTERMAP_BASIS
HM Land Registry uses OS MasterMap as the basis for its plans.
HMLR_URBAN_SCALE_1250
HM Land Registry broadly uses 1:1250 title plans for urban land.
HMLR_RURAL_SCALE_2500
HM Land Registry broadly uses 1:2500 title plans for rural land.
HMLR_MOOR_SCALE_10000
HM Land Registry broadly uses 1:10000 title plans for mountain and moorland land.
HMLR_TITLEPLAN_WITH_REGISTER
A title plan must be viewed together with the register and filed documents referred to in the register.
PL_API_OVER_100_DATASETS
The Planning Data API exposes more than 100 planning and housing datasets through one interface.
PL_API_POINT_INTERSECTION
Latitude and longitude parameters return entities whose geometries intersect the query point.
PL_API_MULTIPLE_DATASETS
A point query can include multiple dataset parameters.
PL_API_UPRN_MORE_PRECISE
The documentation describes UPRN lookup as more precise than coordinate lookup for registered properties.
PL_API_ABSENCE_CAVEAT
An empty result does not prove that no planning constraint exists because coverage varies by area.
PL_API_NO_BATCH_USE_BULK
The API has no batch endpoint; bulk downloads are recommended for hundreds of properties or more.
PL_TITLE_BOUNDARY_INDICATIVE
Title-boundary polygons show the position and indicative extent of a registered property.
PL_TITLE_BOUNDARY_TOTAL_2595903
The live title-boundary dataset reports 2,595,903 title boundaries.
EA_DTM1_COVERAGE_99
The Environment Agency 1 metre composite DTM covers approximately 99 percent of England.
EA_DTM1_RESOLUTION_1M
The composite DTM has 1 metre spatial resolution.
EA_DTM1_2022_PERIOD
The current composite was produced in 2022 from surveys undertaken between 6 June 2000 and 2 April 2022.
EA_DTM1_GEOTIFF_5KM
The data is supplied as GeoTIFF rasters in 5 kilometre tiles aligned to the OS National Grid.
EA_DTM1_VERTICAL_REFERENCE
Elevations are in metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn using OSTN15; input surveys state plus or minus 15 centimetres RMSE vertical accuracy.
EA_WCS_RAW_PIXELS_201
The Environment Agency documents WCS 2.0.1 as the service for raw pixel values such as elevation.
OS_T50_TILE_POST
OS Terrain 50 grid data uses 50 metre post spacing and is supplied in 10 kilometre by 10 kilometre tiles.
OS_T50_GRID_200_BY_200
Each OS Terrain 50 ASCII grid tile contains 200 columns and 200 rows, with values calculated from pixel centres.
OS_T50_HEIGHT_PRECISION_01
OS Terrain 50 grid heights are supplied to the nearest 0.1 metre.
OS_T50_RMSE_4M
OS Terrain 50 grid data has been verified to 4 metre RMSE.
